notes.note: Reviewed afb673d observer-order correction: fixture defers hostile bundle response until diagnostic listeners exist, including the report source/origin check; teardown resolves pending response before server close. This eliminates missed one-shot report timing without changing product APIs, recovery, trust or native command authority. Earlier Windows baseline and mutation receipts retain their dated source scope; final rerun is separate.
